row.name: Cencora Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=10 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.49 tightness=0.93 base_volume_vs_leg=0.96 base_volume_vs_avg=1.03
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: the base gave back 0.49 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: volume did not exceed the prior session's

notes: extension: close -2.2% vs its 20-SMA, -0.5% over 20 sessions

claude.reason: The base shaded on the chart is visibly a rounding top / distribution zone sitting just below the prior highs near 338, not a tight consolidation — bars inside the box are wide and overlapping with multiple red sessions, and the giveback of 0.49 of the leg confirms the stock surrendered nearly half its prior advance before this burst. The burst bar itself is honest (closes near the high, opens lower), but volume came in at only 31% of the prior session's level, and range expansion failed both the 5- and 10-bar tests, meaning there is no evidence of institutional participation on the breakout day. The prior leg's efficiency ratio of 0.29 is below the A+ threshold and the chart shows a choppy, stair-step advance rather than persistent buying, weakening the linearity argument despite the R² pass.
claude.key_risk: The base is a failed breakout zone with heavy overhead supply from the 330–339 area where the stock spent several weeks at elevated volume, making a sustained follow-through unlikely.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below today's burst close of 316.49 or if the first 30 minutes show a fade back toward the 310 area on any meaningful volume.

row.summary: COR: +2.5% on 0.3× volume out of a base 10.1% deep. C 8.0, 5 of 6 criteria.
